Use ChitChat to Live Chat with Our Customers

This training gets you ready to handle live chat in ChitChat, our customer support platform. It includes two introductory modules and an interactive practice experience. By the end, you'll be able to set your status to Available, find your inbox and accept a chat; respond using conversation history; choose the right ticket status (Open, Snoozed, or Done); and use ChatterBox to find answers for customers.
